note: Human text for every stable honesty code. Clients key behaviour on the code (the object key), never on the text; the code is also exposed in title/aria-label. Wording follows ADR 0003 section 7: an absence of evidence is worded as 'not observed', and no string claims what the program did or did not do beyond what was observed.

markers.redacted: Value withheld by a redaction rule.
markers.truncated: Value cut at its size limit; only the retained prefix is shown.
markers.dropped: Value or event was dropped before it was stored.
markers.gap: Events were not recorded here; the reason is shown.
markers.unavailable: Not observed; the reason is shown.
markers.mismatch: The source file on disk differs from the file the recording saw.
markers.source_missing: The source file is not on disk.
markers.inferred: Inferred from static analysis, not observed at runtime.
markers.unmatched: Not linked to a catalog operation.
markers.handler_unresolved: The handler behind this route could not be resolved.
markers.correlation_gap: Correlation between events was lost here.
markers.capacity_dropped_events: Events past the per-recording capacity were dropped and counted.
markers.object_unavailable: A stored object for this recording is missing.
markers.object_corrupt: A stored object for this recording failed its checksum.
markers.orphan_parent: The parent frame was not observed.
markers.legacy_unindexed: Recorded before frame indexing existed; counts are not available.

sourceStatus.observed_unattested: source as read when the class loaded

sourceBindings.verified: Source verified against the build attestation.
sourceBindings.attestation_missing: No build attestation was available for this class.
sourceBindings.class_bytes_mismatch: The loaded class differs from the build attestation.
sourceBindings.debug_metadata_absent: The class has no line table.
sourceBindings.source_metadata_invalid: The build attestation for this source was invalid.
sourceBindings.observed_unattested: Source as read when the class loaded; no build attestation vouches for it.
sourceBindings.source_map_absent: Generated file observed; no source map was found.
sourceBindings.source_map_unresolved: A source map exists but this position could not be resolved.

unavailableReasons.capability_unsupported: The adapter does not support this capability.
unavailableReasons.debug_metadata_absent: Debug metadata is absent, so this was not observed.
unavailableReasons.capture_budget_exhausted: The capture budget was used up before this was sampled.
unavailableReasons.recorder_disconnected: The recorder disconnected before this was sampled.
unavailableReasons.privacy_policy_unavailable: No verifiable privacy policy covered this value, so it is not shown.
unavailableReasons.focused_capture_not_armed: Focused capture was not armed; relaunch with focused capture to record this.
unavailableReasons.unsafe_to_render: Not safe to render, so not shown.
unavailableReasons.class_not_transformable: The class could not be instrumented.

dropReasons.sequence_gap: A sequence gap made this unrecoverable.

gapReasons.line_budget: Line events were not recorded: the line budget was exhausted.
gapReasons.value_budget: Values were not recorded: the value budget was exhausted.
gapReasons.throttle: Events were not recorded while the daemon throttled the adapter.
gapReasons.queue_full: Events were not recorded: the adapter queue was full.
gapReasons.correlation_lost: Events were not recorded: correlation was lost.
gapReasons.class_not_transformed: Events were not recorded: the class could not be instrumented.
gapReasons.module_loaded_before_arm: Events were not recorded: the module loaded before probes were armed.
gapReasons.source_map_absent: Positions were not resolved: no source map was found.
gapReasons.handled_exception_unobserved: A handled exception cannot be observed here.
gapReasons.child_process_not_instrumented: A child process was started and is not instrumented.
gapReasons.bootstrap_consumed: The bootstrap material was already used.

outcomeKinds.exception_propagated: An exception propagated out of the application.
outcomeKinds.client_aborted: The client went away before a response.
